Ek PDF f(x) = c·x hai jab 0 ≤ x ≤ 2, aur baaki jagah 0. Constant c ki value kya hai?
questions.explanation: Graph ek triangle hai: base 2, height f(2) = 2c. Area = ½ × 2 × 2c = 2c = 1, toh c = 1/2. Trap 1/4: triangle area me ½ bhool jaana (2 × 2c = 4c = 1).

questions.question: Customer ke aane ka waiting time Exponential hai jiska mean 5 minute hai. Wait 5 minute se zyada hone ki probability kya hai? (e⁻¹ ≈ 0.368)
questions.explanation: Mean 5 hai toh λ = 1/5 = 0.2. P(X > 5) = e^(−0.2 × 5) = e^(−1) ≈ 0.368. Trap 0.5: mean ko median maan lena; exponential symmetric nahi hai. 0.632 = P(X ≤ 5) hai.

questions.question: Ek bulb ki life Exponential hai jiska mean 1000 ghante hai. Bulb 500 ghante chal chuka hai. Woh aur 1000 ghante chalne ki probability kya hai?
questions.explanation: Exponential memoryless hai: P(X > 1500 | X > 500) = P(X > 1000) = e^(−1000/1000) = e^(−1) ≈ 0.368. Trap e^(−1.5): yeh P(X > 1500) hai, jo condition ko ignore karta hai.

questions.question: X ~ Uniform(4, 16). E[X] kya hai?
questions.explanation: Uniform(a, b) ka mean = (a + b)/2 = (4 + 16)/2 = 10. Trap 8: sirf b/2 lena. Trap 6: (b − a)/2 lena, jo interval ki aadhi length hai, mean nahi. 12 sirf interval ki length hai.

questions.question: X ~ Exponential(λ = 0.25). X ka mean kya hai?
questions.explanation: Exponential ka mean = 1/λ = 1/0.25 = 4. Trap 0.25: λ ko hi mean maan lena. Trap 16: 1/λ² lena. 0.75 = 1 − λ, jiska yahan koi matlab nahi.

questions.question: X ek continuous random variable hai aur P(X ≤ 3) = 0.4 hai. P(X < 3) kya hai?
options: Isse nikalne ke liye f(3) chahiye
questions.explanation: Continuous RV me P(X = 3) = 0, isliye P(X < 3) = P(X ≤ 3) − P(X = 3) = 0.4. Trap 0.6: yeh P(X > 3) hai. f(3) ki zaroorat nahi, kyunki ek single point ke neeche ka area zero hota hai.

questions.question: X ~ Uniform(2, 8). Var(X) kya hai?
questions.explanation: Var = (b − a)²/12 = (8 − 2)²/12 = 36/12 = 3. Trap 36: 12 se divide karna bhool jaana. Trap 0.5: square bhool ke 6/12 lena. 5 mean hai, variance nahi.

questions.question: X ~ Exponential(λ = 0.5). P(2 < X < 4) kya hai? (e⁻¹ ≈ 0.368, e⁻² ≈ 0.135)
Ek PDF f(x) = k(4 − x) hai jab 0 ≤ x ≤ 4, aur baaki jagah 0. P(X < 2) kya hai?
questions.explanation: Graph ek triangle hai: base 4, height f(0) = 4k. Area = ½ × 4 × 4k = 8k = 1, toh k = 1/8. x = 2 se 4 tak chhota triangle hai: base 2, height f(2) = 2/8 = 0.25, area = ½ × 2 × 0.25 = 0.25 = P(X > 2). Toh P(X < 2) = 1 − 0.25 = 0.75. Trap 0.5: 2 ko beech ka point dekh ke aadha area maan lena; density x = 0 ke paas zyada hai. 0.25 = P(X > 2) aur 0.125 = k hai.

questions.question: X ~ Uniform(0, 10). Diya hai ki X > 4. P(X > 7 | X > 4) kya hai?
questions.explanation: P(X > 7 | X > 4) = P(X > 7 aur X > 4) / P(X > 4) = P(X > 7) / P(X > 4), kyunki X > 7 hone pe X > 4 apne aap hai. P(X > 7) = 3/10, P(X > 4) = 6/10, toh answer = 3/6 = 0.5. Trap 0.3: condition ignore karke P(X > 7) lena. 0.6 = P(X > 4) aur 0.7 = P(X < 7) hai.

questions.question: Ek machine ka repair time X ~ Exponential(λ = 0.2) hai (mean 5 ghante). Woh time m kya hai jiske liye P(X > m) = 0.5 (yaani median)? (ln 2 ≈ 0.6931)
questions.explanation: P(X > m) = e^(−0.2m) = 0.5. Dono taraf ln lo: −0.2m = −ln 2, toh m = 0.6931 / 0.2 = 3.4655 ≈ 3.47 ghante. Trap 5: mean ko median maan lena; exponential symmetric nahi hai, isliye median mean se kam hai. Trap 0.139: λ se divide ki jagah multiply karna (0.6931 × 0.2). 2.5 sirf mean ka aadha hai.

questions.question: Continuous RV X ka CDF F(x) = x²/9 hai jab 0 ≤ x ≤ 3 (x < 0 pe F = 0, aur x > 3 pe F = 1). P(1 < X < 2) kya hai?
questions.explanation: P(1 < X < 2) = F(2) − F(1) = 4/9 − 1/9 = 3/9 = 1/3. Continuous hone se < aur ≤ me farak nahi. Trap 4/9: sirf F(2) = P(X ≤ 2) lena. 5/9 = 1 − F(2) = P(X > 2) hai, aur 1/9 = F(1).

weeks.title: Normal distribution
weeks.summary: Bell-shaped Normal distribution, uske parameters μ aur σ, 68-95-99.7 rule aur z-score se standard normal table use karke probabilities nikalna seekhoge.
concepts: **Normal distribution** N(μ, σ²) ek symmetric bell-shaped curve hai jiska center μ pe hai; σ batata hai curve kitna phaila hua hai.
Normal me **mean = median = mode = μ**, aur curve μ ke dono taraf mirror image hota hai.
**Empirical rule (68-95-99.7)**: lagbhag 68% data μ ± σ me, 95% μ ± 2σ me, aur 99.7% μ ± 3σ me hota hai.
**z-score** z = (x − μ) / σ batata hai ki x mean se kitne SD door hai. Isse koi bhi normal **standard normal** Z ~ N(0, 1) ban jaata hai.
**Φ(z)** = P(Z ≤ z), standard normal table se milta hai. Symmetry se Φ(−z) = 1 − Φ(z) aur P(Z > z) = 1 − Φ(z).
**Linear transform**: agar X normal hai toh aX + b bhi normal hai, mean aμ + b aur SD |a|σ ke saath.
**Reverse problem** (cutoff nikalna): pehle table se z dhundo, phir x = μ + zσ.

example.problem: Exam ke marks N(μ = 60, σ = 10) follow karte hain. Random student ke 75 se zyada marks aane ki probability kya hai? (Φ(1.5) = 0.9332)
steps: Answer: lagbhag 6.68% students ke 75 se zyada marks hain.

mistakes: z-score me variance se divide kar dena. Agar σ² = 25 diya hai toh σ = 5 se divide karo, 25 se nahi.
'Greater than' wale sawal me 1 − Φ(z) karna bhool jaana. Table hamesha left side ka area (P(Z ≤ z)) deta hai.
Top 5% cutoff ke liye 1.96 use karna. 1.96 two-sided 95% ke liye hai; one-sided top 5% ke liye 1.645 lagta hai.

questions.question: Normal distribution me mean, median aur mode ke beech kya relation hai?
options: Mode hamesha sabse bada hota hai
questions.explanation: Normal curve μ ke around perfectly symmetric hai, isliye peak (mode), beech wala point (median) aur average (mean) teeno μ pe hote hain. Mean > median > mode right-skewed data me hota hai.

questions.question: Empirical rule ke hisaab se normal data ka lagbhag kitna hissa μ − 2σ aur μ + 2σ ke beech hota hai?
Heights N(μ = 165 cm, σ = 5 cm) follow karti hain. 177 cm height ka z-score kya hai?
questions.explanation: z = (177 − 165) / 5 = 12 / 5 = 2.4. Height mean se upar hai toh z positive hoga. Trap 12: σ se divide karna bhool jaana.

questions.question: X ~ N(μ = 50, σ = 8). Empirical rule se P(42 < X < 66) lagbhag kitna hai?
questions.explanation: 42 = μ − σ aur 66 = μ + 2σ. μ − σ se μ tak = 68% / 2 = 34%, aur μ se μ + 2σ tak = 95% / 2 = 47.5%. Total = 34 + 47.5 = 81.5%. Trap: sirf ek side (68% ya 95%) le lena.

questions.question: Z standard normal hai aur Φ(1) = 0.8413. P(Z > −1) kya hai?
questions.explanation: Symmetry se P(Z > −1) = P(Z < 1) = Φ(1) = 0.8413. Trap 0.1587: yeh P(Z > 1) hai; 0.6826 = P(−1 < Z < 1) hai. Probability kabhi negative nahi hoti.

questions.question: Marks N(μ = 70, σ = 10) follow karte hain. Top 5% students ko A grade milta hai. A grade ka minimum cutoff kya hai? (Φ(1.645) = 0.95, Φ(1.96) = 0.975)
questions.explanation: Top 5% matlab cutoff ke neeche 95% area: Φ(z) = 0.95, toh z = 1.645. Cutoff = 70 + 1.645 × 10 = 86.45. Trap 89.6: 1.96 use karna, jo top 2.5% ka cutoff hai. Trap 90: 2σ ko 5% maan lena.

questions.question: Marks N(μ = 80, σ = 6) follow karte hain. 71 marks ka z-score kya hai?
questions.explanation: z = (71 − 80) / 6 = −9 / 6 = −1.5. Value mean se kam hai, toh z negative hoga. Trap 1.5: sign bhool jaana. Trap −9: σ se divide karna bhool jaana. −0.67 = 6 / (−9), formula ulta laga dena.

questions.question: Empirical rule ke hisaab se normal data ka lagbhag kitna percent hissa μ − σ se μ + σ ke bahar hota hai?
questions.explanation: μ ± σ ke andar lagbhag 68% hota hai, toh bahar 100 − 68 = 32% (dono taraf 16% 16%). Trap 68%: andar wala hissa batana. Trap 16%: sirf ek taraf ki tail lena. 5% toh ±2σ ke bahar ka hissa hai.

questions.question: X ~ N(μ, σ²) ho toh Z = (X − μ) / σ ka mean aur standard deviation kya hain?
questions.explanation: μ ghatane se mean 0 ho jaata hai, aur σ se divide karne se SD σ/σ = 1 ho jaata hai. Isliye Z ~ N(0, 1), yaani standard normal. Trap 'μ aur σ': standardize karne ke baad original parameters nahi rehte. Trap '0 aur σ': σ se divide karna SD ko bhi badal deta hai.

questions.question: Ek fruit ka weight N(μ = 60 g, σ = 5 g) follow karta hai. P(65 < X < 70) kya hai? (Φ(1) = 0.8413, Φ(2) = 0.9772)
X ~ N(μ = 20, σ = 3). Y = 2X − 5 ka distribution kya hai?
questions.explanation: Normal ka linear transform bhi normal hota hai. Mean = 2 × 20 − 5 = 35, SD = |2| × 3 = 6. Trap 'SD 1': SD me se bhi 5 ghatana. Trap 'SD 36': variance 2² × 9 = 36 ko SD likh dena. Trap 'mean 40': −5 bhool jaana.

questions.question: Marks N(μ = 55, σ = 12) follow karte hain. Bottom 10% students ko remedial class milti hai. Iska cutoff kya hai (jiske neeche wale students remedial me jaate hain)? (Φ(1.28) = 0.90)
questions.explanation: Cutoff ke neeche 10% area chahiye: Φ(z) = 0.10. Symmetry se Φ(−1.28) = 1 − 0.90 = 0.10, toh z = −1.28. Cutoff = 55 + (−1.28) × 12 = 55 − 15.36 = 39.64. Trap 70.36: z ka sign positive le lena (yeh top 10% ka cutoff hai). Trap 53.72: σ se multiply karna bhool jaana (55 − 1.28). Trap 43: seedha μ − σ lena.

questions.question: X normal hai, μ = 100, aur P(X > 120) = 0.0228 hai. σ kya hai? (Φ(2) = 0.9772)
questions.explanation: P(X > 120) = 0.0228 ⇒ P(X ≤ 120) = 1 − 0.0228 = 0.9772 = Φ(2), toh 120 ka z-score 2 hai. (120 − 100) / σ = 2 ⇒ σ = 20 / 2 = 10. Trap 20: z se divide karna bhool jaana. Trap 40: z se divide ki jagah multiply karna. 0.1 = 2 / 20, formula ulta karna.

questions.question: Ravi ne Maths me 78 marks liye (class: μ = 70, σ = 4) aur Sneha ne Stats me 85 (class: μ = 75, σ = 8). Dono classes ke marks normal hain. Apni class ke relative kaun better hai, aur us student se zyada marks wale classmates lagbhag kitne percent hain? (Φ(1.25) = 0.8944, Φ(2) = 0.9772)
questions.explanation: Ravi: z = (78 − 70)/4 = 2. Sneha: z = (85 − 75)/8 = 1.25. Ravi ka z bada hai, toh woh apni class me relatively better hai. Ravi se upar = P(Z > 2) = 1 − 0.9772 = 0.0228 = 2.28%. Trap Sneha: raw marks (85 > 78) ya mean se raw gap (10 > 8) compare karna, SD ignore karke. Trap 97.72%: Ravi se neeche wale students ka percent batana. 10.56% Sneha se upar wale students ka percent hai.

questions.question: X ~ N(μ = 50, σ = 10). P(X < 35 ya X > 65) kya hai? (Φ(1.5) = 0.9332)
questions.explanation: z-values: (35 − 50)/10 = −1.5 aur (65 − 50)/10 = 1.5. Har tail = 1 − 0.9332 = 0.0668, aur symmetry se dono tails barabar hain: total = 2 × 0.0668 = 0.1336. Trap 0.0668: sirf ek tail lena. Trap 0.8664: yeh beech ka hissa P(35 < X < 65) hai. 0.9332 = P(X < 65) hai.
